notation: WCA/SiGN; wide moves lowercase; slices M E S; rotations x y z
description: Corners of the Last Layer: with F2L solved and all LL edges oriented, orient and permute the LL corners in one alg, leaving an EPLL (Ua/Ub/H/Z or skip). 40 non-trivial cases with misoriented corners + 2 oriented-corner swap cases = 42.
notes: algs[0] is the primary. Case state for a case = inverse(algs[0]) applied to a solved cube.
pre_auf[i] = number of clockwise U turns to do on that case state BEFORE algs[i] (0 for the primary). Some alts also start with a y/y2/y' rotation.
After any alg, a post-AUF may be needed; only corners are guaranteed solved (edges permuted = EPLL).
Trigger-grouping parentheses from jperm.net were removed; otherwise moves are verbatim from the cited source.
Recognition text is auto-derived from the simulated case state (relative colours), not copied from a source.
Verified with an independent sticker simulator: every alg preserves F2L, orients all LL pieces and solves LL corners (mod AUF) for its case.
